## Final model

`log(1+Y) = -0.732 +0.620·X1 +1.126·X2`

n = 35, S = 1.713, R² = 32.8%, adj R² = 28.6%, predicted R² = 21.3%, F-test p = 0.0017

|                 |   Coef |   SE Coef |   T-Value |   P-Value |   95% CI low |   95% CI high |     VIF |   Boot 2.5% |   Boot 97.5% |
|:----------------|-------:|----------:|----------:|----------:|-------------:|--------------:|--------:|------------:|-------------:|
| Constant        | -0.732 |     1.518 |    -0.482 |     0.633 |       -3.824 |         2.36  | nan     |      -3.712 |        3.167 |
| X1_enjoyment    |  0.62  |     0.186 |     3.34  |     0.002 |        0.242 |         0.998 |   1.009 |       0.2   |        0.951 |
| X2_good_weather |  1.126 |     0.626 |     1.797 |     0.082 |       -0.15  |         2.401 |   1.009 |       0.216 |        2.071 |

Standardized β: X1 Enjoyment +0.49, X2 Good weather +0.26

Interpretation: each +1 enjoyment point multiplies (1 + weekly off-screen minutes) by e^0.620 ≈ +86% (95% CI +27% to +171%), holding the other terms fixed.

## Assumption checks (final model)

- Normality: Shapiro–Wilk p = 0.019, Anderson–Darling A² = 0.875 (5% crit 0.735)
- Constant variance: Breusch–Pagan p = 0.045
- Independence: Durbin–Watson = 2.16
- Multicollinearity: max VIF = 1.01
- |std residual| > 2: observations [13, 29, 35]; max Cook's D = 0.131 (obs 8)
